Interface TlsParameters

All Superinterfaces:
TlsParameters
@Deprecated(forRemoval=true) public interface TlsParameters extends TlsParameters
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
use TlsParameters
Abstraction for setting TLS parameters to be used by ATNA sender implementations. Use DefaultAuditContext.setTlsParameters(org.openehealth.ipf.commons.core.ssl.TlsParameters) (TlsParameters)} to configure the audit context.

The default uses the default as defined by javax.net.ssl.* system properties.
